MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable and Fire TV Stick fit my TV use: one helps connect equipment, while the other adds streaming to the television I already have.",
    "The USB hub fits my history of using USB accessories and a card reader; individual switches would make those devices easier to manage, although ten ports may exceed my needs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 24-port switch and six short Ethernet cables assume a wired-networking project that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "The internal SSD does not serve the same purpose as my removable memory cards, and the USB-B cable needs a specific device connection I do not currently need.",
    "The Echo Dot and smart plug introduce voice control and automation when my accessory purchases have been about practical connections and everyday device use."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics accessories seems to have been treated as interest in almost any electronics upgrade, regardless of what equipment it supports.",
    "My Fire tablet and power strips seem to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices and smart-home features, even though those purchases served specific practical needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: my memory cards, mounts, lens cap, and charging cables serve particular devices, so a broadly related accessory is useful only if it fits equipment I use.",
    "My repeated camera and removable-memory purchases suggest continued interest in supporting those activities, which these recommendations barely address.",
    "The scale of the accessory matters: a large network switch or ten-port hub can exceed my needs, and 4K capability adds little for my 720p TV.",
    "Both Fire TV Sticks fit the same streaming need, but I would choose one rather than buy both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in practical device accessories, but stretch that into unrelated upgrades without enough attention to compatibility and current purpose."
}
